Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on assays.tid, molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, and compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter to target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293191', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', and activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id then canonical_smiles then target_type then tax_id then standard_type then pchembl_value. Limit to 1000 rows.
